prompt.title: Change control needed
prompt.beforeSave: This laboratory requires an approved change control for this change. Choose the change control that covers it before saving.
prompt.fieldHelp: Search by number or title, or type the number.
prompt.empty: No change control is approved for implementation for this laboratory. If you know the number, type it.
prompt.loadFailed: The list of approved change controls could not be loaded. Type the change control number instead.
prompt.invalidNumber: Use capital letters, digits and hyphens only, up to 20 characters.
prompt.noMatch: No change control matches your search.
prompt.cancelled: Not saved: no change control was chosen.
